scripts.build: if [ -n "$CI" ]; then check=check:only; else check=check; fi; for dir in */; do [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] || continue; (cd "$dir" && npm run "$check" --if-present && npm run build --if-present && npm test --if-present) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:deps: for dir in */; do [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] || continue; (cd "$dir" && npm run build:deps --if-present) || exit 1; done
